## 🚨Registo no dia🚨
Esta competição vai ter registo no dia. Se planeias registar-te no dia da competição, envia um e-mail com os eventos em que tencionas participar, e indica também o teu evento favorito, a cidade onde vives, e outro hobby teu. Adiciona uma foto tua no email, de preferencia uma foto a competir, para uma surpresa que estamos a planear para os competidores.  
## 🚨 Registration on the spot🚨
This competition will have on the stop registration. If you plan to register on the stop, please email us with the events you plan to compete in, and please comment your favorite event, hometown and another hobby you have. If you have a picture of yourself competing, or any picture if it is your first time competing, please attach it to the email, for a surprise we are planning for competitors

[Segue-nos no Instagram / Follow us on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/azemeisopen23/)
Se vais competir pela primeira vez, certifica-te que lês todas as informações em [Informação Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzemeisOpen2026#73828-informacao-importante-important-information), *[ Perguntas Frequentes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzemeisOpen2026#73829-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* e no [Regulamento WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
Se és associado da APS tens direito a um **desconto exclusivo de 20%**, sabe mais [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzemeisOpen2026#73836-associados-aps-aps-associates).
•
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in [Important Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzemeisOpen2026#73828-informacao-importante-important-information), the *[FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzemeisOpen2026#73829-perguntas-frequentes-faq)* and the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/).
If you're an APS associate you can take advantage of an **exclusive 20% discount**, find out more [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/AzemeisOpen2026#73836-associados-aps-aps-associates).
